halfmasa.gui.title: halfmasa Configs
halfmasa.gui.copy_all: Copy all waypoints as one bundle
halfmasa.message.screenshot_copy_failed: Failed to copy screenshot to clipboard
halfmasa.config.generic.comment.openWayp: Opens the halfmasa configuration and waypoint tools screen
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.enableW: Stores Xaero root IDs in the singleplayer save so restores and folder renames keep using the same waypoint and map data; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.copyWay: Copies all normal waypoints in the current Xaero world as one compressed XWB1 text bundle
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.importW: Imports an XWB1 waypoint bundle from the clipboard into the current Xaero world
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.shareCu: Sends every normal waypoint in the current Xaero set to chat using Xaero's native share format
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.shareAl: Sends all normal waypoints in the current Xaero world to chat using Xaero's native share format
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.dedupeC: Removes later waypoints whose coordinates and name both match an earlier waypoint in the current set
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.dedupeA: Deduplicates each waypoint set independently using coordinates and waypoint name
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.waypoin: Ticks to wait between waypoint chat messages; ten ticks is half a second
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.enableG: Master switch for the creative G-key full-inventory action; inspired by TechUtils (The Unlicense); source https://github.com/VelizarBG/techutils; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.giveFul:
In creative mode, press G to create a full container using these rules:
- Main-hand regular item, empty offhand: shulker box filled with the item
- Main-hand regular item, container offhand: offhand container filled with the item
- Main-hand regular item, bundle offhand: insert items according to the bundle fill count
- Empty shulker box in main hand, empty offhand: chest filled with stacked shulker boxes
- Empty shulker box in main hand, container offhand: offhand container filled with stacked shulker boxes
- Filled shulker box in main hand, empty offhand: chest filled with full shulker boxes
- Filled shulker box in main hand, container offhand: offhand container filled with full shulker boxes
- Container nesting safety blocks unsafe nesting when enabled; inspired by TechUtils (The Unlicense); source https://github.com/VelizarBG/techutils
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.bundleF: Number of stack insertion attempts when the offhand target is a bundle
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.fillSaf: Prevents unsafe nested containers and shulker boxes
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.itemSea: Records items obtained after creative searches and displays an independent history area above creative search results; storage and UI are independently implemented by halfmasa; disabled by default
Maximum rows shown by the creative search history area from 1 to 9; defaults to 3
Keeps history above results while search text is present; when disabled, obtained items are still recorded and history returns after clearing the search field; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.itemManag: Keeps separate REI and JEI histories for recipe and usage lookups and successful item retrieval; history uses whole-screen corners while the native item list shortens to make room and its column count and slot spacing are reused for alignment; UI references JEI Recipe History (MIT) source https://github.com/christofmeg/JEI-Recipe-History; compatibility references REI (MIT) https://github.com/shedaniel/RoughlyEnoughItems and JEI (MIT) https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems; disabled by default
Rows shown by the REI and JEI history grids from 1 to 9; defaults to 3
Anchors history to a corner of the entire game screen while the native item list makes room; defaults to bottom-right
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.cycleItem: Cycles the history panel through bottom-right, top-right, top-left, and bottom-left; unbound by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.customSav: Expand to add multiple saves paths and switch them from the top-left of the singleplayer world screen
Singleplayer saves path list; switch paths immediately from the world selection screen
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.keepWorld: When enabled, clicking Singleplayer with no worlds in the current saves path stays on the world selection screen instead of opening world creation automatically; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.customSav: Legacy singleplayer saves directory setting; relative paths use the game directory
halfmasa.custom_saves.label: Saves Path
halfmasa.custom_saves.tooltip:
Current singleplayer saves path: %s
Click to manage; hold for 1 second to move the button
halfmasa.custom_saves.title: Choose Custom Saves Path
halfmasa.custom_saves.path_description: Absolute paths and paths relative to the game directory are supported
halfmasa.custom_saves.add_failed: Path is empty, invalid, or already exists
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.screensho: Copies the full image to the system clipboard whenever F2 saves a screenshot
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.skipResou: Treats added resource packs as compatible and skips the version mismatch confirmation; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.elytraTim: Shows estimated remaining flight time from durability and Unbreaking in elytra tooltips; inspired by ElytraTime (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/Linter2/ElytraTime
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.reportEly: Shows the equipped elytra's remaining flight time in chat; inspired by ElytraTime (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/Linter2/ElytraTime; the hotkey is disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.nightVisi: Smoothly fades Night Vision before it expires instead of using vanilla's final 10-second flicker; default: 5 seconds, set to 0 to disable early fading
Replaces vanilla's expiring Night Vision flicker with a configurable smooth fade; disable to restore vanilla behavior; enabled by default
Controls whether the Night Vision fade duration setting is shown
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.boatView3: Removes the local player's +/-105-degree boat view limit; inspired by BoatView360 (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/AsOne2020/BoatView360; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.boatItemV: Keeps first-person held items visible while rowing makes the player's hands busy; inspired by Boat Item View (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/50ap5ud5/BoatItemView; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.inventory: Allows movement, jumping, and sneaking in vanilla inventory and container screens; inspired by InvMove and InvMoveCompats (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/PieKing1215/InvMoveCompats; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.client.name.disablePause: Disable Paused Client Item Trajectory Prediction
halfmasa.config.client.prettyName.disabl: Disable Paused Client Item Trajectory Prediction
halfmasa.config.client.comment.disablePa: Stops client-side dropped-item trajectory prediction while the server is frozen by Carpet or vanilla /tick freeze; tick stepping still updates normally; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.disabled.comment.disable: Stops client-side block rendering for water, lava, and other fluids without changing fluid logic, collisions, or server state; disabled by default
Stops client-side block rendering for flowing fluids while source blocks remain visible; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.disabled.comment.entityR: Renders one representative and shows its name and count when matching mobs or item entities exceed the threshold; entities still tick, collide, and interact normally; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.disabled.comment.entityA: Hides the representative model for aggregated groups and keeps only the name and quantity label; entities still tick, collide, and synchronize normally; disabled by default
Maximum three-dimensional distance for chained matching-entity aggregation, default: 1 block
Only one representative is rendered when the matching entity count is strictly above this value, default: 10
Client tick interval between entity-count scans, default: 10 ticks or about half a second; larger values reduce scan cost but update labels less often
Controls whether the name and count appear above or beside the representative entity
No list aggregates every eligible entity, whitelist only aggregates listed types, and blacklist excludes listed types
Entity type IDs to aggregate when list mode is Whitelist, for example minecraft:zombie or minecraft:item
Entity type IDs excluded from aggregation when list mode is Blacklist, for example minecraft:zombie or minecraft:item

halfmasa.feature.give_full_inventory.cre: Container fill only works in creative mode
halfmasa.feature.give_full_inventory.emp: Hold an item in your main hand

halfmasa.gui.keybind_editor.title: Keybind Wheel Entries
halfmasa.feature.server_icon_cache.clear: Failed to clear the server icon cache
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.fastWorld: Independently rebuilt early world-loading close while preserving the required initial state; inspired by Force Close World Loading Screen (MIT) without copying its source; attribution https://github.com/kennytv/kennytvs-epic-force-close-loading-screen-mod-for-fabric; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.fastResou: Independently rebuilt early resource-reload overlay close while preserving the required initial state; inspired by Force Close World Loading Screen (MIT) without copying its source; attribution https://github.com/kennytv/kennytvs-epic-force-close-loading-screen-mod-for-fabric; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.betterSav: Allows individual items to be inserted into or replaced in saved creative hotbars, middle-click deletion, and retained scroll position; data is stored in config/halfmasa/better-saved-hotbars/hotbar.nbt; inspired by Better Saved Hotbars (CC0-1.0); source https://github.com/LukynkaCZE/better-saved-hotbars; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.keybindPi: Shows a wheel selector when multiple keyboard or mouse actions share a key; inspired by KeybindsGalore Plus (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/av306/KeybindsGalore-Plus; disabled by default
Ticks between repeated activations while a selected action is held
Ticks to suppress the trigger key after an action is selected and released, preventing the same key from immediately closing a newly opened screen
Clears the client attack cooldown when the attack action is selected
Comma-separated GLFW key codes ignored by the conflict pie
Treats the ignored-key list as an allow list
Number of vertices used to draw the pie circle
Enables transparent color blending in the pie
Darkens the game behind the pie
Uses the menu blur behind the pie when available
Draws a shadow under pie labels
Expansion multiplier for the selected sector
Extra spacing around the pie
Distance labels move inward from the edge
Overall pie size
Center area that cancels selection
Base sector color
Selected sector color
Highlighted label color
Brightness added to alternating sectors
Sector opacity from 0 to 255
Alternates sector brightness
Animates the pie opening
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.openKeybi: Opens the per-key name, category, and sector color editor
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.clickAndS: Sends run_command click text without a leading slash as ordinary chat; inspired by LetMeClickAndSend (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/Fallen-Breath/LetMeClickAndSend; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.cjkLatinS: Adds display spacing between Chinese text and adjacent Latin words or numbers; supports a toggle hotkey and expandable controls for translations, signs, and editable or written books without changing stored sign or book text; disabled by default
Applies Chinese-English spacing to translated menus, item names, and mod configuration text while keeping width measurement and wrapping accurate; enabled by default
Adds Chinese-English display spacing when signs are rendered without changing their stored text; enabled by default
Adds Chinese-English display spacing in Book and Quill editing and written-book reading while keeping cursor, selection, and click positions mapped to the original text; enabled by default
Controls whether the independent translation, sign, and book display toggles are shown
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.mapInSlot: Renders filled map contents inside hotbar and inventory slots while retaining count and decoration layers; inspired by Map In Slot (MIT); source https://github.com/Crec0/map-in-slot; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.mapInHotb: Controls map previews in the hotbar while no inventory screen is open
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.mapInInve: Controls map previews while an inventory or container screen is open
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.serverIco: Restores cached server maps while offline or before refresh, selecting the most recently updated match; enabled by default
Matches normalized server name and address, name only, or address only
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.clearServ: Deletes cached server icons and their index after confirmation
halfmasa.feature.server_icon_cache.clear: This will delete all cached server icons and the cache index. Continue?
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.toastKill: Stops current toasts and rejects new ones while enabled; inspired by Toast Killer (Apache-2.0); source https://github.com/anopensaucedev/Toast-Killer; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.serverPin: Expands the server ping executor and clears stale queued work during refresh; inspired by ServerPingerFixer (MIT); source https://github.com/JustAlittleWolf/ServerPingerFixer; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.contingam: Windows JNI input method with composition and candidate overlays, temporary and persistent modes; ported from XPlus ContingameIME (LGPL-2.1); source https://github.com/Wudji/XPlus-ContingameIME; Home only works after this switch is enabled; disabled by default
Controls whether IME child settings are shown
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.imeDisabl: Disables IME after a slash except for msg, tell, and tellraw; off by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.imeAutoRe: Replaces configured leading characters with a slash; on by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.imeSlashC: Characters replaced by a leading slash, default: Chinese enumeration comma
halfmasa.config.waypoint.comment.waypoin: Expand or collapse waypoint import, sharing, interval, and deduplication settings
halfmasa.config.map_server.comment.mapSe: Expand or collapse inventory map preview and server map cache settings
halfmasa.config.ported.name.cooldownAuto: Hold Left Mouse to Auto Attack
halfmasa.config.ported.prettyName.cooldo: Hold Left Mouse to Auto Attack
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.cooldownA: Attacks the entity under the crosshair when the vanilla attack cooldown is ready; uses the normal client attack request and is disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.draggable: Enables independently implemented resource-pack and server list dragging; inspired by Draggable Lists (GPL-3.0-only); source https://github.com/mrmelon54/draggable_lists; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.fastScrol: Accelerates horizontal and vertical scrolling in the current screen, including MaLiLib config screens, while a configured modifier is held, without affecting the in-game hotbar; adapted from Fast Scrolling (MIT); source https://github.com/Mat0u5/FastScrolling; disabled by default
Independently enables the first fast-scrolling modifier and multiplier; enabled by default
Hold to use mode one's multiplier; default: Left Ctrl; key combinations are supported
Interface scrolling multiplier for mode one, from 1 to 32; default: 2
Independently enables the second fast-scrolling modifier and multiplier; mode two wins when both match; enabled by default
Hold to use mode two's multiplier; default: Left Ctrl + Left Shift; key combinations are supported
Interface scrolling multiplier for mode two, from 1 to 32; default: 6
Controls whether the switches, modifiers, and multipliers for both fast-scrolling modes are shown
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingA: Places against adjacent support faces ahead, above, or below when the crosshair misses a block; the toggle hotkey is configurable; adapted from Bridging Mod (MIT); source https://github.com/CloudG360/BridgingMod; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingM: Starts searching for bridging targets at this percentage of the player's interaction range; 0–100, default: 20
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingO: Calculates and uses reach-around targets only while the player is crouching; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingA: Restricts reach-around placement to horizontal support faces, vertical support faces, or both; default: both
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingC: Overrides the normal bridging axes while crouching; default: same as the normal setting
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingP: Delay before held right-click responds again after a successful reach-around placement; 0–20, default: 4 (vanilla speed)
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingS: Shows the up, down, or horizontal placement direction in first person when a valid bridging target exists; enabled by default
Outlines the world position where the next block will be placed; enabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingO: ARGB color and opacity of the bridging target outline; default: translucent black
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingS: Adjusts horizontal click height for slabs and trapdoors using the player's foot height; enabled by default
Excludes torch blocks from reach-around placement to reduce accidental use; enabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingR: Allows reach-around placement to replace vanilla-replaceable blocks such as tall grass; disabling selects only air; enabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingP: Auto uses the camera in first person and player eye direction in other views; camera mode supports free-look while still enforcing player interaction reach
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingS: Controls how widely nearby blocks around the view line can enter the candidate list; 0–1, default: 1
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingA: Allows snapping to the strict path or nearby blocks sharing faces, edges, or corners; default: faces, edges, and corners
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.bridgingE: Controls whether detailed reach-around bridging settings are shown
halfmasa.option.bridging_adjacency.corne: Include Face, Edge, and Corner Neighbors
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.draggable: Expand or collapse resource-pack and server list dragging; independently implemented and inspired by Draggable Lists (GPL-3.0-only); source https://github.com/mrmelon54/draggable_lists
Controls resource-pack list reordering; disabled by default
Controls server list reordering; disabled by default
Hides resource-pack entry move arrows; enabled by default
Hides server entry move arrows; enabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.condensed: Condenses similar creative inventory variants into expandable entries; ported from Wisp Forest Condensed Creative (MIT); source https://github.com/wisp-forest/CondensedCreativeItems; the halfmasa implementation still runs when the standalone mod is installed, so keeping only one implementation is recommended; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.keepModMe: Remembers separate scroll positions for Mod Menu and every MaLiLib configuration category during the current game session; independently implemented after reference to KeepMyScroll (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); source https://github.com/My-Pal-is-a-Dog/keepmyscroll; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.condensed: Groups enchanted book variants into one expandable entry
Groups tipped arrow variants into one expandable entry
Groups regular, splash, and lingering potion variants into separate expandable entries
Cycles the icon shown by collapsed entries once per second
Draws a translucent background over condensed entries
Draws a border around condensed entries
Color used for condensed entry backgrounds and borders
Shows the expand or collapse action, child count, and source in the parent entry tooltip
